name: Moonwalk
design_intent: ORBIT circuit 1 of 3 (owner 2026-07-18: 'could be fun to play with gravity in another trial circuit too'). Lesson: A PLANET IS A FLOOR IN EVERY DIRECTION. One moon (body_r 200, field r 1000, g 1300); you spawn on the north pole and the goal ring hangs 220px BELOW the south pole - still inside the field, so 'down' is always the moon and the ring is reached by bouncing around the planetoid (each surface touch refunds +20). Falling out of the field drops you into global-down space and out the bottom bound = free respawn. Ring size 300 is generous; the skill is trusting the curved floor. Sample orbit math: trampoline apex 270 off the surface keeps you well inside the r 1000 field (200+270 << 1000), so casual bounces can never escape the moon.
hint: THE MOON IS THE FLOOR — BOUNCE AROUND IT
